Build occupancy detection histories for all qualifying species

Source: R/06_occupancy.R
pam_build_occupancy.Rd

Reads cleaned detections and the audio master, constructs per-species detection history matrices (wide format), occasion covariates (effort and Julian date), and site covariates. Writes everything to data/occupancy/<run_id>/.

Usage

pam_build_occupancy(cfg, run_id = cfg$occupancy$run_id, force = FALSE)

Arguments

cfg

A list from pam_config_read.

run_id

Character. The detection run to use. Defaults to cfg$occupancy$run_id.

force

Logical. Rebuild even if outputs exist? Default FALSE.

Value

Invisibly, a list with histories (named list of wide matrices), effort, site_covariates, summary.

Details

Occasion definition

Each occasion is one calendar day (midnight to midnight in the project timezone). Days with less than min_effort_hours of recording are coded NA (not surveyed).

Site definition

Grids with a single deployment use the grid name as the site ID. Grids with multiple deployments get grid_deployment_id.

Confidence thresholds

If processing.species_thresholds_file points to a CSV with columns scientific_name and threshold, those per-species values are used. Species not listed fall back to processing.min_confidence.

Species filter

Only species with at least occupancy.min_detections total detections (after the confidence cut) get a history matrix.
